welcome.title: Welcome to AskCalls
welcome.body: Your calls are encrypted on your devices before they're uploaded. We store them, but we can't read them.
welcome.body2: Next: a passkey to unlock them, and a recovery code in case you lose it.

passkey.title: Create a passkey
passkey.body: You'll unlock AskCalls with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
passkey.cancelled: Passkey wasn't created. Try again or use a passphrase.
passkey.noPrf: This browser can't unlock AskCalls with a passkey yet. Use a passphrase on this device.
passkey.browsers: Browsers that can: Chrome, Edge and Safari 18 or later, Firefox 135 or later.
passkey.label: Passkey

pass.title: Create a passphrase
pass.label: Passphrase
pass.hint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence works well.
pass.failed: Couldn't create keys on this device. Try again.

rc.title: Save your recovery code
rc.body: It's the only way back in if you lose your passkey. We can't reset it.
rc.copied: Copied. Clear your clipboard after saving.
rc.hint: Print it or keep it in a password manager, not only on this device.
rc.check: I saved my recovery code somewhere safe

file.name: AskCalls recovery code.txt
file.heading: AskCalls recovery code
file.use: Use it at {url} if you lose your passkey.

confirm.title: Check your saved code
confirm.body: Type group {a} and group {b} from your saved copy.
confirm.wrong: Group {n} doesn't match. Check your saved copy.
confirm.failed: Couldn't save your keys. Check your connection and try again.

try.title: Try it with a sample call
try.body: A short made-up call about a kitchen quote. You can delete it later.
try.failed: Couldn't import the sample call. Try again.
try.searchHintEn: Search for "pirce". The typo is on purpose.
try.searchHintHe: Search for "מחיק". The typo is on purpose.
try.searchPlaceholder: Search names, numbers, tags or words

ai.title: Connect your AI
ai.body: The askcalls agent lets Claude or any MCP client search and read your calls on this computer.

where.claudeDesktop: Settings → Developer → Edit Config, then restart Claude Desktop:

ai.tokens: Tokens for other tools are in <link>Settings → API and MCP</link>.
